We've got beds there. A different kind of stay. A different kind of organisation. HI is the charity that invented hostelling — over 2,000 hostels across more than 50 countries, all held to one global standard, all part of something bigger than a booking. We're not a chain and we're not an app. We're a hundred-year-old movement built on the idea that travel should mean something, and that anyone should be able to do it. Explore our story Hostels Explore our incredible locations No two HI hostels are the same - and that's the point. Over 2,000 of them across 50+ countries, each shaped by its place, all held to one global standard.
